Excited to share that I’ve joined Fluxion AI as a Software Engineer Intern! Over the past few weeks, I’ve been building Python-based automation tools for processing simulation data, cost modelling, and scenario-driven financial analysis. It’s been a great experience applying software skills to solve real-world challenges in infrastructure and operations. Looking forward to learning more and contributing to impactful projects!
